description: SST* makes Stable Sparse RRT *asymptotically optimal*: with more iterations, the best trajectory converges to an optimal one. It runs SST in epochs. After each epoch, both the selection radius and the pruning radius shrink by a factor `ξ` between 0 and 1, and the next epoch is longer, so the tree can grow denser. Like SST, it needs only forward simulation, not a steering function. Use it when you want the cost to keep improving over a long run and can give it more memory over time.

papers.authors: Yanbo Li, Zakary Littlefield, Kostas E. Bekris
papers.title: Asymptotically optimal sampling-based kinodynamic planning
papers.venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research

lineage.source: sampling-planning, src/kinodynamic/sst.rs: "SST is asymptotically near-optimal; with an SstStarSchedule it becomes SST*, which is asymptotically optimal"
